purpose: Independent non-executable file-level Commons attribution and depicted-place research for three underrepresented Central African countries; no runtime integration or image download.
reviewMethod: Each exact Wikimedia Commons File page was inspected for creator, location/subject description, and stated Creative Commons licence. File-page assertions are not an independent verification of photographer identity, unmodified image pixels, or availability of image bytes.
displayRequirements: Show creator, exact file-page source, licence link, and changes notice. Preserve CC BY-SA terms on modifications. Revalidate Commons metadata and visually inspect pixels before any production display.
productionStatus: EDITORIAL RESEARCH ONLY; NOT INSTALLED, NOT DEPLOYED, NO USER DATA MODIFIED
